correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed Cayley adjacency of Shrikhande and coordinate-sharing rook graph, verified both SRG(16,6,2,2) with different local neighborhoods C6 and 2K3. Enumerated 2^16 vertex masks for each by forbidden connected triples; 176 forbidden triples each and face vectors R (16,120,384,528,144), S (16,120,384,544,240,32), 1192 and 1336 nonempty faces. Independently constructed prescribed greedy acyclic Hasse matchings (542 and 638 pairs), with critical cells dimensions 0:1,2:1,3:106 for rook and 0:1,2:1,3:58 for Shrikhande. Calculated signed integral 3-to-2 Morse coefficients exactly: R {-1:8,0:82,1:16}, S {-1:10,0:43,1:5}; each has unit coefficient, so a 2-cell and one 3-cell cancel homotopically, leaving wedge^105 and wedge^57 3-spheres, respectively. No torsion follows from actual homotopy cancellations, not mod-two Betti inference.
residual_risks: Only the two named sixteen-vertex graphs and cutoff 2, not all SRGs.
